instruction: Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v.out`, `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v.dat`. Then write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\yield.json` with `runs`, `passing`, and `yield`, representing the stepped corners whose `V(OUT)` is within `5.050 V +/- 0.008 V`. `yield` is a fraction in the range [0, 1], computed as `passing / runs`, not a percentage from 0 to 100. The JSON must be derived from the native stepped measurement in `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ref_5v_measure.txt`. [Software] Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`.
